<MethodEndpoint

:::caution[deprecated]

This endpoint has been deprecated and may be replaced or removed in future versions of the API.

:::

Adds a releasable unit of work (e.g. a pick task) to a process path's `WorkPool` — the EnqueueWorkUnit use case. `workUnitId` is client-supplied and must be unique within the pool: enqueueing the same `workUnitId` twice returns `409 Conflict` (`work-unit-already-enqueued`) rather than silently creating a duplicate entry — this endpoint is idempotent-by-client-supplied-ID in that sense, though not a pure no-op retry (a second call with the same ID is rejected, not silently accepted). If this is the first unit ever enqueued against the path, a `WorkPool` is auto-provisioned as release-fed with a default WIP limit. Publishes `WorkUnitCreated`.
A unit becomes a pack-aware pick (`workKind` `CASE_PICK` / `EACH_PICK`) when the body carries `quantity` (eaches), `pickUnit` or `fromBin`, or a `BREAK_CASE` when it carries `caseBreak` (ADR-0045); both need a `sku` and the two never mix. A `CASE` pick needs an active CASE pack level in the local copy and a whole number of cases.

**Idempotency (ADR-0022).** This resource-creating POST requires a caller-supplied `Idempotency-Key` header. The first request with a given key is processed and its response (status, headers, body — a 4xx included) is stored in the same database transaction as the write; a retry with the same key and the same body replays that stored response verbatim and does not enqueue again. A missing key is `400 idempotency-key-required`; the same key with a different body is `409 idempotency-key-reused`. Use a fresh key per logical action. A replay carries `Idempotency-Replayed: true`.
Superseded by the K1 choreography (X3): order-management publishes `OrderAllocated` / `OrderPartiallyAllocated` and this service's `ApplyOrderAllocated` consumer enqueues one work unit per line (OM ADR 0005 / WP ADR-0031); removal planned with the next breaking window.
